steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page shows your research work: data readiness, a running ledger of ideas you have tested, how they held up over time, and whether any idea graduated. Let's see it.
steps.point_out: The page heading 'Playbook Signals' appears at the top. Below are seven collapsible sections showing your research state.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness
steps.narration: This section shows how much data you have on hand: the symbol-dates covered, the daily minutes, and a table of past recordings with their quality score in the 'Fallback frac' column.
steps.point_out: The section opens. You see a summary table of corpus totals and below it a table with columns including 'Fallback frac', showing data quality for each recording.

steps.title: Expand Scout Ledger
steps.narration: The Scout Ledger holds every quick idea you have tested: the screening results, whether each passed or failed, and integrity proof. The ledger is chain-verified so you can trust the record is complete.
steps.point_out: The section opens. You see 'Ledger chain verification:' followed by 'ok' or an error message, confirming the record is intact and unbroken.

steps.title: Expand Walk-Forward
steps.narration: This section shows how your ideas hold up when tested forward over time, fold by fold. It also has chain verification to prove the fold records are genuine and unbroken.
steps.point_out: The section opens. You see 'Ledger chain verification:' confirming the walk-forward record is complete.

steps.title: Navigate to the Cockpit
steps.narration: The Cockpit is your live market workspace. It shows a real-time tape of orders and quotes, watched price charts, and a control panel showing your current read of market pressure for each tracked symbol.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit loads. You see 'No ticker watched' because we have not asked it to track any symbol yet.

steps.title: Add a ticker to watch
steps.narration: Type a symbol name into the Ticker field. This tells the Cockpit to stream live market data for that symbol.
steps.point_out: The ticker field is filled and ready for the next step.

steps.title: Click Watch
steps.narration: Clicking Watch activates the live tape reader for this symbol. It begins flowing market data through your pressure algorithm in real time.
steps.point_out: A panel labeled 'Buyer Control' appears, showing that the tape reader is live and has generated its first pressure reading.

steps.title: Navigate to the Structure page
steps.narration: The Structure page is a support-resistance wall map. It shows where the real price levels are on a chart—the exact points where supply or demand is so concentrated that they stand out. Enter a symbol and a date, and it computes and displays the map for that exact moment.
steps.point_out: The Structure page loads. You see the heading 'Tradable Map' and fields ready for a symbol and date.

steps.title: Enter symbol and date
steps.narration: Enter AAPL as the symbol and 2026-06-22 16:00:00 (Eastern Time) as the date to load the structure map for that exact moment in time.

steps.title: Enter the as-of date
steps.narration: This date tells the Structure page exactly when to measure the wall.

steps.title: Load the structure map
steps.narration: Click Load to compute and display the support-resistance band for this symbol and date. This is the real AAPL wall at that exact moment—the exact levels where supply and demand meet.
steps.point_out: The map appears. You see the resistance band labeled '300.11–302.2', the real wall example that has been shipped and verified in every iteration.
